summary: Bail in UAPA and state security law case; prolonged undertrial detention (5 years); panch witnesses turned hostile; fundamental right to speedy trial under Article 21 emphasized; 100 witnesses questioned for efficiency; Malak Khan precedent cited on selective witness examination; bail granted with conditions including geographical restriction and online appearance; automatic bail cancellation on breach.
legal_provisions_cited: Unlawful Activities Prevention Act, 1967 s.10, s.13, s.17, s.38(1)(2), s.40, s.22-A, s.22-C
Chhattisgarh Vishesh Jan Suraksha Adhiniyam, 2005 s.8(2), (3), (5)
Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.120B, s.201, s.149, s.34
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order denying bail set aside; appellant released on bail subject to conditions.
